saw_lines: Candy buyers pick a bar by taste first, then check the label, so a health claim alone rarely closes the sale.
So the sale is won in the ad, where taste and the no sugar added claim must show before the click.
Your 15 Google creatives split into 8 images, 6 text and 1 video, so test three new text ads built on the free shipping above $50 offer.
ads_1: Google image ads for the caramel bars, with free shipping in the first line
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube
